en: The image is a monochrome (likely early 20th-century) postcard showing a rural mountain setting. There are several stone buildings with tile roofs situated by a rocky stream and surrounded by dense forest and steep hillsides. A covered structure, possibly a bridge or mill, is visible to the right. The scene is tranquil and rustic. At the top, printed text reads '20. SANT HILARI SACALM. Molí d’En Buscà.'
